verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a facility for defining rules that automatically trigger actions on events. The nearest items are adjacent: turn events used to collect transcripts, built-in barge-in interruption behavior, and Flows functions the LLM calls to move between conversation nodes. These are framework primitives and fixed behaviors, not a documented event-to-action rules capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
